scope: Locality/account-gate audit of original 40 products and proposed unified-suite/lite-CMS scope

methodology.facts: Official vendor/project architecture and expiry docs; prior capability/adoption inventory
methodology.inference: Independent implementation feasibility, clustering, effort and product roadmap
methodology.limits: No premium binaries installed/tested; no network capture; no bypass; no exact parity or measured market-demand claim

L.label: Application-local
L.description: Can be implemented in local application/PHP/browser using local storage; listed dependencies must be supported by host.

W.label: Owner-hosted worker
W.description: Still self-hostable on the same VPS; needs a process/binary/container, model, system scheduler or substantial resource budget.

E.label: External connector
E.description: Local glue to another system, protocol or provider; not necessarily vendor SaaS, but not isolated origin-only operation.

D.label: Outside failure/network domain
D.description: Needs another location, independent observer, upstream capacity or distributed edge. Can sometimes be owner-managed rather than SaaS.

I.label: External intelligence/data
I.description: Local engine can consume it, but a single site cannot generate the same proprietary/global/current dataset.

clusters.title: Content model & editorial
clusters.examples: ACF; WPCode; Code Snippets; Elementor dynamic content
clusters.scope: Field definitions, typed records, relations, repeaters, revisions, options and permissions.
clusters.rationale: One schema drives editor, forms, structured data and templates.

clusters.title: Design & presentation
clusters.scope: Blocks, patterns, layout rules, dynamic bindings, templates, navigation and popups.
clusters.rationale: Use existing WordPress blocks first; visual-builder parity is a large separate product.

clusters.title: SEO & local discovery
clusters.scope: Metadata, schema, redirects, sitemaps, links, local business data and multilingual URLs.
clusters.rationale: Output generation is local; Google performance/rank data is a connector.

clusters.title: Forms & workflow
clusters.scope: Fields, entries, uploads, conditions, calculations, signatures and queued actions.
clusters.rationale: Reuse schema/conditions/queue; CRM and payment APIs are optional adapters.

clusters.title: Identity, access & learning
clusters.scope: Roles, restricted content, drip, courses, progress, quizzes and member entitlements.
clusters.rationale: Access rules are local; commercial subscription collection is external.

clusters.title: Commerce & reservations
clusters.scope: Catalog, inventory, orders, coupons, calendars, resource capacity and entitlement state.
clusters.rationale: Keep existing WooCommerce for plugin route; do not rebuild broad commerce in an initial lite CMS.

clusters.title: Media & performance
clusters.examples: WP Rocket; LiteSpeed; WP-Optimize; Fastest Cache; Smush; Imagify; ShortPixel; EWWW
clusters.scope: Caching, image codecs, lazy loading, cleanup, asset optimization and expensive generation jobs.
clusters.rationale: Pure PHP baseline with optional owner-hosted workers; CDN stays separate.

clusters.title: Analytics & conversion
clusters.scope: First-party events, funnels, experiments, heatmaps, popups and campaign reports.
clusters.rationale: Share events and consent; reports need not be stored in a SaaS account.

clusters.title: Email, CRM & audience
clusters.examples: WP Mail SMTP; MC4WP; Jetpack newsletter
clusters.scope: Mail queue/logs/retries, lists, segments, templates, opt-ins and customer fields.
clusters.rationale: Local controls are easy to separate from SMTP deliverability and external contact platforms.

clusters.title: Security, consent & abuse
clusters.examples: Wordfence; Really Simple Security; Complianz; Akismet
clusters.scope: Local 2FA, rate limits, headers, audit trail, script blocking, consent records and rule engines.
clusters.rationale: Threat feeds, crowdsourced spam intelligence and human response are separate services.

clusters.title: Backups, recovery & migration
clusters.examples: UpdraftPlus; Duplicator; All-in-One Migration; Jetpack; ManageWP
clusters.scope: Consistent snapshots, scheduling, retention, encryption, restores, exports and site moves.
clusters.rationale: Local backup engine plus user-chosen independent copy and standalone recovery tool.

clusters.title: Development & fleet operations
clusters.examples: ManageWP; WPCode; Code Snippets; MainWP-style management
clusters.scope: Module ownership, settings export, cron/queues, health logs, permissions and client workflows.
clusters.rationale: One package; independent modules; optional separate owner-hosted fleet controller.

plugin_profiles.name: Elementor
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Theme templates, widgets, responsive layout, popups, dynamic fields and local form submissions.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: AI generation, shared cloud kits/services, delivery and hosted products excluded from core.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified restriction: current help limits new/edited premium operations after expiry. Renewal article uses broader “stop” wording; precise frontend impact is not established. Account/license activation is distinct from executing layout code.

plugin_profiles.name: Essential Addons for Elementor
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Widgets, menus, post displays, galleries, protected sections and conditional presentation.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Remote social feeds/third-party form platforms and template-cloud libraries become optional adapters.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid widget/module packaging is verified. No claim that all paid rendering requires a live account; expiry enforcement was not independently verified.

plugin_profiles.name: ElementsKit
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Header/footer, mega menus, galleries, interactions and conditional content.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Social/meeting integrations and remote template assets excluded or optional.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Local capability tiers are commercial entitlements; runtime account and expiry behavior not verified.

plugin_profiles.name: Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Repeaters, flexible layouts, galleries, clone fields, options and block definitions.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Update/download/support portal; no cloud compute inherently required for field editing.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified: without activation, Pro field definition authoring is restricted. Previously activated expired licenses can edit existing definitions but cannot create new Pro definitions. Content values and frontend rendering remain unaffected.

plugin_profiles.name: WPCode
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Snippet insertion, local conditions, revisions, scheduling, safe testing, permissions and pixel event wiring.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Private vendor cloud library and AI excluded; ad-platform event endpoints optional.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid local tools are tier-gated; exact network checks and expiry behavior not verified. Conditions/revisions can be independently implemented without a vendor account.

plugin_profiles.name: Code Snippets
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Snippet organization, CSS/JS/PHP insertion, editor integration and local revision workflows.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Vendor cloud sync and AI excluded; self-managed export/sync is feasible.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Pro feature packaging documented; runtime/expiry enforcement not verified.

plugin_profiles.name: Yoast SEO
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Redirects, schema, metadata, sitemaps, breadcrumbs, local/video/news output and link analysis.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: AI/content suggestions, support/training and remote search data outside local core.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid output/editor tools are commercial gates. Exact offline license behavior not verified; do not classify all paid SEO as cloud-backed.

plugin_profiles.name: Rank Math
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Schema builder, redirects, metadata, local-location records, image rules and internal-link analysis.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: SERP/rank observations, Search Console data and vendor AI require external data/services.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid site/client and keyword allowances mix licensing with services. Exact offline/expiry handling of each module not verified.

plugin_profiles.name: All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Link suggestions, redirects, schema, local business records, sitemaps and metadata.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Search Statistics relying on Google performance/index data and hosted AI are excluded/connectors.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid local and service features coexist; no blanket claim that every paid feature needs the account at runtime.

plugin_profiles.name: WPForms
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Conditional forms, stored entries, uploads, multi-step forms, surveys, calculations, signatures and user/content creation.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Stripe/other payments, CRM/marketing APIs and hosted AI remain optional.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified renewal FAQ allows continued use of installed Pro version. Add-on downloads, support/updates and payment fee entitlements are distinct from core form execution.

plugin_profiles.name: Gravity Forms
plugin_profiles.popularity: Vendor claim: 5M+ websites; definition not independently audited
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Conditional forms, entry storage, uploads, surveys, registration, quizzes and local workflow actions.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Payment and CRM/messaging systems require adapters and their own credentials.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified installed products continue after expiry; updates/support/downloads and new-site registration stop. Even a recovery/reinstall registration can require a renewed license.

plugin_profiles.name: WP Mail SMTP
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Queueing, routing, logs, resend, fallback connections, reports and local mail templates.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Actual delivery uses an owner MTA or chosen SMTP/API service; Gmail/Microsoft integrations inherently need their credentials.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid local observability is a packaging choice; exact expiry effects on every log/routing feature not verified. Provider OAuth is not a plugin-vendor account gate.

plugin_profiles.name: MC4WP: Mailchimp for WordPress
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Forms, segments, opt-in records, reporting and customer/purchase sync logic can have a local equivalent.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: The existing product fundamentally connects to Mailchimp; use a local audience engine if avoiding that account.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Official sources conflict: pricing says premium access ends; newer expiry KB says installed plugin continues. Do not claim a confirmed runtime shutoff. Mailchimp credentials remain inherent to this integration.

plugin_profiles.name: OptinMonster
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Popup builder, exit-intent/device triggers, scheduled offers, A/B tests and conversion tracking.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip its hosted campaign account/analytics implementation; remote targeting datasets and integrations optional.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Existing product uses hosted authoring/reporting and plan quotas. This is genuine SaaS as sold, but ordinary popup/experiment logic does not inherently require SaaS.

plugin_profiles.name: MonsterInsights
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: First-party visits/events, forms/store conversions, dimensions, funnels and in-admin reports.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: GA4 reporting, Google-owned history and ad-platform attribution cannot be recreated from origin data alone.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Existing Google Analytics integration needs Google credentials. A local metrics engine replaces the job, not the identical underlying GA4 dataset. Paid report packaging is separate.

plugin_profiles.name: Wordfence
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Request filtering, login controls, 2FA, integrity checks, file scans and local audit logs.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Fresh proprietary rules/signatures, reputation network and analyst response excluded from core.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Free/paid API keys and premium intelligence timing are documented. Local security engine and continually researched feed are different deliverables.

plugin_profiles.name: Really Simple Security
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Hardening, security headers, TOTP/passkeys, login policies and local request rules.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Vulnerability intelligence/certificate authorities and any ongoing remote services separate from controls.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Commercial gates on local security controls are verified at capability level; exact runtime account requirement unknown.

plugin_profiles.name: Akismet
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Honeypots, local challenge/rate rules, moderation heuristics and a locally maintained classifier can cover basic anti-spam.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Do not promise Akismet network intelligence or equivalent detection accuracy; current classification calls its servers.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: API key is genuinely used for remote comment classification. This is not just an arbitrary lock on a shipped local classifier.

plugin_profiles.name: Complianz
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Consent UI, script blocking, local consent records, preference categories, region rules and data-request workflows.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Maintained legal/cookie databases, geo-IP data and external CMP/ad registrations separate.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid local operations can be independently designed; exact account/expiry controls were not audited. Region-aware UI does not guarantee correct legal configuration.

plugin_profiles.name: Jetpack
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Local events/stats, request protection, publishing, forms, newsletter management and snapshot orchestration.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip vendor backup vault, image/video CDN, hosted search/AI and remote security/spam services.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Service bundles need connected accounts as implemented. Some functionality is ordinary local software; vendor vault/network services have genuine external infrastructure.

plugin_profiles.name: UpdraftPlus
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Backup creation, precision schedules, incremental files, retention, encryption, update snapshots, restoration and migration.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Vault/storage is separate; owner SFTP/secondary storage can avoid the plugin vendor account.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified: installed Premium remains accessible after term ends; updates/support/new releases stop. Premium scheduling does not inherently need vendor compute.

plugin_profiles.name: All-in-One WP Migration
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Package export/import, URL replacement, selected data movement, local scheduling and restore tools.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Cloud destination accounts optional; skip vendor-service dependencies for a new local engine.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid extensions unlock local import/CLI/size workflows. Exact expiry/network enforcement not verified; avoid assuming “Unlimited” removes all host limits.

plugin_profiles.name: Duplicator
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Installable archives, local scheduling, encrypted backups, restores, clone/staging and selective migration.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Optional vendor cloud storage or external destination accounts.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid automation/large-site workflows are local-capable; runtime/expiry controls not independently verified.

plugin_profiles.name: ManageWP Worker
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Bulk update orchestration, inventories, permissions, client reports and self-hosted fleet management.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip vendor dashboard/cloud backup/remote uptime; a separate owner-hosted controller can replace management.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Worker is a connector to the hosted control plane, not a complete independent dashboard. MainWP demonstrates the owner-hosted alternative.

plugin_profiles.name: LiteSpeed Cache
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Asset/media settings, cleanup and caching with a compatible local LiteSpeed server.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: QUIC.cloud CDN and remote image/page optimization require service usage as implemented.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: No paid Pro plugin. Server/CDN requirements are technical deployment dependencies; OpenLiteSpeed is an option. Local cache should not be mislabeled as a license-locked Pro feature.

plugin_profiles.name: WP Rocket
plugin_profiles.popularity: Vendor claim: 5,594,000+ websites; not comparable to directory active installs
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Page caching, preload, JS scheduling/lazy loading and ordinary on-host optimization.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Current CSS-generation and performance services, limited CDN and remote compatibility feeds excluded.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified: local plugin continues after expiry; cloud features stop 15 days later. CSS output on disk does not mean it was generated locally. A new local generator needs its own implementation/resources.

sources.title: WP Rocket expiry: local versus cloud
WP Rocket Remove Unused CSS architecture

plugin_profiles.name: WP Fastest Cache
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Caching, mobile/widget variations, minification, database cleanup and local lazy-load controls.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Metered image processing and CDN integrations must be checked separately; substitute local codecs.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: One-time licenses exist; image credits are distinct. Not all image processing is proven local in the vendor product.

plugin_profiles.name: WP-Optimize
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Cache/DB cleanup, precise scheduling, role/geographic cache rules, media cleanup and asset settings.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Cloudflare API/remote integrations optional; image backend must be checked rather than assumed local.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Installed TeamUpdraft software continuation is documented generally. Individual feature network paths not audited.
plugin_profiles.evidence: Local feasible; backend details partly unknown

plugin_profiles.name: Smush
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Resize/compress/convert images, lazy loading, dimensions and local preload hints.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip current remote compression/CDN; keep the underlying optimization job using local libraries.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Docs confirm compression API sends images to third-party servers. Account/Hub gates coexist with an actual remote pipeline; it is not currently an offline compressor.
plugin_profiles.evidence: Documented remote pipeline; feasible local replacement

plugin_profiles.name: Imagify
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Compression, resizing, WebP/AVIF generation, backups and bulk processing with local codecs.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip current API optimization quotas; no global CDN parity promised.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: API performs compression remotely. Completed files stay locally, which is different from account-independent processing of future files.

plugin_profiles.name: ShortPixel Image Optimizer
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Image transformation/format conversion, resizing and local image metadata management.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip vendor optimization cloud/CDN/hosted AI and credit accounting.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Official FAQ confirms original images go to its optimization cloud. Same general tasks can be implemented locally without promising identical compression output.

plugin_profiles.name: EWWW Image Optimizer
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Existing local optimization and locally stored original-image backups; own codec processing.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Skip API compression, Easy IO/CDN and vendor backup services.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Local mode is documented and needs command-line support/exec for relevant tools; some host environments require cloud fallback.

plugin_profiles.name: Polylang
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Language-linked records, menus, slugs, strings, duplicate/sync workflows and multilingual commerce data.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Own-key DeepL or other machine translation is optional; manual translations remain local.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: License described for updates/support. Exact backend enforcement is not independently tested; no blanket no-account assurance for all Pro installation workflows.

plugin_profiles.name: TranslatePress
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Visual/manual translation editing, multilingual routing, local string storage, SEO and translator roles.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Current AI/Google/DeepL translation calls external services; owner-hosted translation worker could substitute.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Terms say expiry removes AI and certain premium features, without a complete feature list. Distinguish retained translated content from ability to use every paid tool.

plugin_profiles.name: WPML
plugin_profiles.popularity: Vendor claim: 1.5M websites / 250,000 users; not directory active installs
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Manual translations, language relationships, strings, URLs and editorial translation workflows.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Paid automatic translation and professional translation network excluded/connectors.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified: existing registered sites continue. New-site registration or changed-URL re-registration requires active subscription, so a migration can encounter an account gate.

plugin_profiles.name: WooCommerce core
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Catalog, carts, orders, inventory, coupons, customer records and local reports.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Payment networks, carrier quotes/labels and specialist external services are adapters.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Core is free; no universal Pro runtime lock. Extension-specific licenses and payment-provider accounts must be distinguished.

plugin_profiles.name: WooCommerce Subscriptions
plugin_profiles.popularity: Woo marketplace: 100K+ active installs; separate from core adoption
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Subscription state, schedules, entitlement rules, renewal events, retries and customer management.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Actual recurring card charges require gateway/payment network. A local scheduler alone cannot settle transactions.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid extension is local software with gateway integration. Exact extension expiry controls not verified; do not equate processor credentials with vendor entitlement.

plugin_profiles.name: WooCommerce Bookings
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Availability calendars, resource capacity, booking rules, group/person pricing and reservation records.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Google Calendar and payment collection optional external adapters.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Commercial booking engine is local-capable; full runtime/expiry behavior not audited. Production concurrency correctness is the substantial engineering work.

plugin_profiles.name: WooCommerce Memberships
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Content access, drip, member discounts/perks, local member administration.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Recurring charges need a billing gateway/Subscriptions-style workflow.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Paid content-access feature is not inherently cloud. Exact expiry/license behavior was not verified.

plugin_profiles.name: MemberPress
plugin_profiles.popularity: Vendor says thousands of creators; no independently verified active-install count
plugin_profiles.local_candidate: Access rules, members, content dripping, course progress, quizzes and community/affiliate records.
plugin_profiles.external_or_excluded: Payments and hosted AI excluded/adapters; large live messaging demands optional workers.
plugin_profiles.account_gate: Verified: admin screens/functions become unavailable after grace period; existing frontend operations remain. Locally stored membership data does not equal perpetual management access.

documented_gates.observed: Pro schema-authoring controls depend on activation. Expired, previously activated licenses allow existing definitions to be edited but prevent new Pro definitions. Data-value editing/rendering stays available.
documented_gates.implication: A direct example of local operations with commercial enforcement; not a cloud-compute requirement.

documented_gates.observed: After expiry and grace period, admin screens/functions become inaccessible; existing frontend operations continue.
documented_gates.implication: Content/member data can remain local while management access is subscription-gated.

documented_gates.observed: Current non-renewal guidance restricts new widgets/tags and some existing premium access; renewal help says Pro features stop. These descriptions differ in breadth.
documented_gates.implication: Clear premium entitlement gate; do not assume the entire live site goes offline or assert exact offline-cache duration.

documented_gates.observed: Existing registered installations continue, but a new site or changed URL requires active subscription for registration.
documented_gates.implication: Migration portability can depend on entitlement even when manual translations are local.

documented_gates.observed: Terms say AI and certain premium features become unavailable after expiry; precise premium feature list is absent. AI text is sent to its service.
documented_gates.implication: Confirmed service dependency; only partial evidence about local-feature enforcement.

documented_gates.observed: Installed core/add-ons continue operating after expiry. Updates, support, downloads and new-site registration stop.
documented_gates.implication: Commercial software without documented shutdown of existing forms; recovery registration remains a dependency.

documented_gates.observed: Renewal FAQ says the installed Pro version remains usable. Downloads/updates/support and gateway fee benefits are separate entitlements.
documented_gates.implication: Do not describe all paid form logic as forced ongoing cloud access.

documented_gates.observed: Vendor says Premium remains accessible after the term; updates/support/new releases stop. Vault space is a distinct service.
documented_gates.implication: Precision scheduling and snapshot logic are local-capable paid software.

documented_gates.observed: Normal plugin operation continues. Documented cloud features cease after 15 days, including CSS generation and performance services.
documented_gates.implication: A real mixed product: remote generation is actual vendor architecture, but a local substitute is technically possible.

documented_gates.observed: Annual expiry leaves installed Pro features available but removes updates/support and new activations. Lifetime licenses are offered. Revocation is a separate documented case.
documented_gates.implication: Already an integrated one-time-purchase benchmark, with commercial license mechanics.

documented_gates.observed: Pricing says premium access ends; expiry KB says continued use without updates/support. Both are current public sources.
documented_gates.implication: Treat actual runtime enforcement as unresolved; Mailchimp account dependence is clear.

documented_gates.observed: Current docs describe an unlicensed core tier and paid entitlements, online revalidation and Enterprise-only offline tokens.
documented_gates.implication: Self-hosting is not the same as unrestricted or account-independent local use.

benchmarks.name: ASE
benchmarks.scope: Custom content types, admin/editor utilities, code snippets, redirects and site operations; existing modular suite.
benchmarks.boundary: 78 modules advertised (counts overlap free/Pro); one-time licenses offered. Annual expiry keeps installed features but stops updates/support/new activations.
benchmarks.gap: Does not establish full SEO/form/commerce/backup parity. Benchmark integration quality and remaining gaps.

benchmarks.name: MainWP
benchmarks.scope: Own WordPress dashboard/controller can manage connected sites without a vendor-hosted control plane.
benchmarks.boundary: Self-hosted design verified; extension accounts/licenses and external services still need individual assessment.
benchmarks.gap: A controller on the failed origin cannot independently detect that outage; controller placement matters.

benchmarks.name: FluentSMTP
benchmarks.scope: Logs, resend, routing/fallback and provider connections demonstrate that these do not need a paid vendor cloud.
benchmarks.boundary: Free product as advertised; actual mail transport still needs owner SMTP/MTA or a provider.
benchmarks.gap: Local logs do not prove recipient inbox delivery.

benchmarks.name: Matomo / Umami
benchmarks.scope: Shows reporting and event analysis can be run on owner infrastructure; Matomo supports on-premise heatmap workflows.
benchmarks.boundary: Cloud hosting is optional; premium analytics plugin entitlements vary.
benchmarks.gap: Not identical GA4 data, Google Search Console or ad-platform attribution; running analytics adds storage/CPU operations.

benchmarks.name: listmonk
benchmarks.scope: Mailing lists, segmentation/campaign engine and queues run on owner infrastructure.
benchmarks.boundary: Own application, database and configured SMTP transport; hosted Mailchimp not inherently needed for the job.
benchmarks.gap: Mail reputation and delivery remain an operational responsibility or chosen external service.

benchmarks.name: restic / imgproxy / LibreTranslate
benchmarks.scope: Demonstrate backup storage, image transformation and translation tasks can be operated outside vendor SaaS.
benchmarks.boundary: Additional processes/libraries/model assets; not guaranteed on ordinary shared WordPress hosting.
benchmarks.gap: These are building blocks, not a single installed WordPress plugin or turnkey parity with the original services.

cms_references.name: ProcessWire
cms_references.scope: Custom fields, repeaters, roles and multilingual content already form a coherent core.
cms_references.fit: Strong reference for schema-first design on PHP infrastructure; learn its integrated model before creating another CMS.
cms_references.gap: A developer still builds the site presentation; richer builders/forms/cache may be paid modules. Not full WooCommerce ecosystem replacement.

cms_references.name: Kirby
cms_references.scope: Content editing and templates on owner hosting; one-time per-install/domain license model.
cms_references.fit: Useful reference for download/install ownership and manual license-file provisioning.
cms_references.gap: Commercial activation still exists. Offline license-file import does not prove every service/add-on is account-free.

cms_references.name: Grav
cms_references.scope: Content pages without a mandatory SQL database; documented server requirements.
cms_references.fit: A plausible lightweight content-site foundation; inspect file-based editing and deployment.
cms_references.gap: Flat files alone do not solve transactional orders, inventory, analytics events or large form-entry workloads. Those often need separate structured storage.

cms_references.name: Payload
cms_references.scope: Integrated admin, schema, migrations, auth, access control, files and generated APIs.
cms_references.fit: Good foundation if a VPS/Node deployment and custom application frontend fit the target.
cms_references.gap: Requires build/runtime/database/storage operations; not a drop-in shared-PHP installation. Enterprise services/features should be assessed separately.

cms_references.name: Drupal
cms_references.scope: Established content-management foundation with modules/themes and several database options.
cms_references.fit: A reference for rich integrated CMS capability and mature extensibility.
cms_references.gap: Feature richness and operating model are not the same as “lite”; migration and ecosystem integration remain work.

cms_references.name: Directus
cms_references.fit: Useful demonstration of local data/control with optional hosted service.
cms_references.gap: Current MSCL core/paid limits and revalidation mean it should not be assumed to satisfy unrestricted account-independent operation. This is a product-doc observation, not a legal assessment.
